triggers.name: assignment_attempts_submitted_immutable
triggers.body:
if OLD.submitted_at is not null then
          if TG_OP = 'DELETE' then
            declare permitted boolean := false;
            begin
              execute format(
                'select true
                 from %I.assignments a
                 join %I.classrooms c
                   on c.id = a.classroom_id
                 join %I.users owner_user
                   on owner_user.id = c.owner_id
                 join %I.users student_user
                   on student_user.id = $2
                 join %I.demo_workspaces w
                   on w.id = owner_user.demo_workspace_id
                  and w.id = student_user.demo_workspace_id
                 where a.id = $1
                   and owner_user.identity_provider = ''demo''
                   and student_user.identity_provider = ''demo''
                   and w.status in (''resetting'', ''expired'')
                 for update of w',
                TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
                TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
                TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
                TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
                TG_TABLE_SCHEMA
              )
              into permitted
              using OLD.assignment_id, OLD.student_id;

              if permitted then
                return OLD;
              end if;
            end;
          end if;

          raise exception 'Submitted attempts are immutable'
            using errcode = '23514';
        end if;

        if TG_OP = 'DELETE' then
          return OLD;
        end if;

        return NEW

triggers.name: problem_versions_immutable
triggers.body:
if TG_OP = 'DELETE' then
          declare permitted boolean := false;
          begin
            execute format(
              'select true
               from %I.problems p
               join %I.users u
                 on u.id = p.owner_id
               join %I.demo_workspaces w
                 on w.id = u.demo_workspace_id
               where p.id = $1
                 and u.identity_provider = ''demo''
                 and w.status in (''resetting'', ''expired'')
               for update of w',
              TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
              TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,
              TG_TABLE_SCHEMA
            )
            into permitted
            using OLD.problem_id;

            if permitted then
              return OLD;
            end if;
          end;
        end if;

        raise exception 'Published problem versions are immutable'
          using errcode = '23514'
